function registerAlert(bytes32 alertId, bytes32 evidenceHash, uint32 version)
function updateReviewStatus(bytes32 alertId, uint8 next, bytes32 evidenceHash, uint32 version)
function getAlert(bytes32 alertId) view returns (tuple(bool exists,uint8 status,uint32 version,address reviewer,uint64 updatedAt))
function getEvidenceHash(bytes32 alertId,uint32 version) view returns (bytes32)
function verifyEvidence(bytes32 alertId,uint32 version,bytes32 supplied) view returns (bool)
event AlertRegistered(bytes32 indexed alertId,bytes32 evidenceHash,uint32 version,address indexed reviewer)
event ReviewStatusUpdated(bytes32 indexed alertId,uint8 status,bytes32 evidenceHash,uint32 version,address indexed reviewer)
